title: Egg landing in a Brazilian town (Moment of Contact)
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Egg landing in a Brazilian town (Moment of Contact), about not stated at small town in Brazil, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Everybody in this little town in Brazil reports seeing an egg landing and it seems to be emitting this sort of like ammonia like thing and even seems to kill a doctor.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a case from a film called Moment of Contact, made with James Fox. According to Michels, everyone in a small town in Brazil reported seeing an egg-shaped object land, and it seemed to give off something like ammonia. He adds that it even seemed to kill a doctor, which would make it a contact event with deadly results.
